propositions: git blame over historical trees can fault blobs one at a time under blobless promisor, causing partial-path failures in derive_caused_by that lead to wrong caused_by links
_blame_file_commits returns [] for both git failure and successful-but-empty blame, making failure indistinguishable from legitimately empty results
derive_caused_by must abort on any per-path blame failure by detecting None return value, preventing incorrect culprit election over a subset of paths
blobless clone with --filter=blob:none reduces size from 1.04 GiB to 68.7 MiB and time from 59s to 14.3s, while --filter=tree:0 must never be used as it produces 3.57 GiB
documentation must record clone guidance with measured numbers and state the accepted git blame degradation under partial object stores
